purpose: Teach: 通告/知らさ/運送/日報/年内/償却/用地/代わる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、解雇の通告、出した日のこと、忘れない。
lines.en: I'll never forget the day we had to issue that first layoff notice.
lines.style: Measured, voice weighted by the memory. Spoken as fact, not complaint. Long pause before the final word to mark its weight. Stays grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、人事方針は、しっかり、知らされております。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are fully briefed on company policy.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Each phrase lands with careful precision. Respectful acknowledgment of the weight of what's being said. Brief, deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 運送業との関係、私の代から、信頼を、築いてきた。
lines.en: We've built trust with our shipping partners over decades. That came from my time.
lines.style: Quiet pride in that lineage. Speaking as steward of something handed down. Steady, unhurried. The slight weight on 'trust' — it's the real currency.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員の日報、私も、毎日、目を通しています。
lines.en: I know. I review the staff reports myself every single day.
lines.style: Direct, almost urgent in its quietness. Wants him to hear that this is being paid attention to — not delegated away. Lean in slightly on 'myself.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 借入の返済、年内に、計画を立てろ。
lines.en: Get a repayment plan for the loans in place before year's end.
lines.style: Command without harshness. The voice of someone used to being listened to. Clear-eyed, practical. No room for drift, but no anger in it either.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業期の設備、すべて、償却を、完了いたしました。
lines.en: Already done. We've fully depreciated all the original equipment.
lines.style: Quick, almost relieved. A checkmark placed. Shows he's ahead on this piece — not waiting for instruction. Professional satisfaction without pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の用地、今でも、残しておけ、大切な土地だ。
lines.en: Keep that original site. Don't sell it. That land matters.
lines.style: Firm finality, but underneath it — tenderness for what that land represents. Hold on the final phrase. This isn't business logic; it's about legacy. Quieter at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんに代わる形で、創業祭の挨拶、私が、いたします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll give the founding day speech this year in his place.
lines.style: Steady, solemn acceptance of that responsibility. Not hesitant, not proud — just clear that he's heard both what was said and what wasn't. The weight of succession settles in.
